messages:
maya: Throwing a weird combo into the void — graphic novels + 80s synth playlists for a rainy weekend. Any recs?
liam: love this. For graphic novels, read 'Blue Monday' by Chynna Clugston Flores for a nostalgic, moody vibe.
zoe: also 'Local Girls' — quieter but hits the melancholic summer notes.
rachel: if you want atmospheric + synth, try the "Sea of Glass" playlist on spotify. linked it in the thread below. :sparkles:
ben: for something darker/graphic — 'Black Hole' pairs surprisingly well with slow, reverb-y synths.
maya: @rachel drop that link? tempted to pair with an animated miniseries later.
reco-bot: Suggested playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX4dyzvuaRJ0n (retro electronic / chillwave)
miles: animated miniseries rec — 'Over the Garden Wall' if you want spooky-but-warm. short, perfect for one-sitting.
zoe: combining: read 'Black Hole' chapters 1-3 while playing reco-bot playlist, then watch 'Garden Wall' ep1. weirdly cohesive.
liam: also, if you want something surf-adjacent but synthy, check out "Surf Noir" mixtape — grainy guitars with synth pads.
rachel: posted the playlist as an album shuffle: ```spotify:playlist:37i9dQZF1DX4dyzvuaRJ0n``` works in the app.
ben: saved. :thumbsup:
maya: ok this is the plan. anyone up for a virtual reading watch party sunday afternoon? 3pm PT?
miles: down.
zoe: me too. can we make it coffee + bad hot chocolate? :laughing:
liam: 3pm PT works. count me in.
rachel: RSVP: yes. will queue supplemental ambient tracks.
reco-bot: Party reminder set for 1719728400 (Sunday 3pm PT). :robot_face:
maya: sweet. will post the short agenda (read 1-3, ep1 watch) 1hr before.
liam: excited. thanks for the random mood drop, maya.
ben: low-effort, high-reward slack thread. :raised_hands:
zoe: love the weekend micro-plan.
maya: saved the playlist and the reading list. see you all sunday!
